dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible pale fringes along the outer edges of the primary and secondary feathers provide a moderate-contrast boundary against the darker inner feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A thin, linear black arc of high contrast situated on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear demarcation where the solid white plumage of the head transitions to the scaled mantle, separated by a distinct black collar band.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white crown and neck plumage contrasting sharply with a narrow, dark semi-collar at the base of the nape.
